description: This Java class, EntityConditionParam, models a parameter for use in prepared statements within the Apache OFBiz framework's entity condition system. It encapsulates a ModelField and its associated value, includes constructors, getters, and a toString method.

classes.name: EntityConditionParam
classes.description: Represents a single parameter to be used in the preparedStatement, holding a ModelField and its value.

methods.name: EntityConditionParam(ModelField modelField, Object fieldValue)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the modelField and fieldValue; throws IllegalArgumentException if modelField is null.

methods.name: getModelField()
methods.description: Returns the ModelField associated with this parameter.

methods.name: getFieldValue()
methods.description: Returns the object value of the field.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining the column name and field value.
